name: Gaslamp Cases 11: The Haunting of Fogley Manor
summary: Detectives Morgan Johnson and Jack Brown are summoned to investigate what they assume is another elaborate hoax - an old manor rumored to be haunted. But within minutes of their arrival, they realize this case is anything but ordinary. Fogley Manor breathes with secrets: murmurs behind closed doors, flickering lights, and echoes of a forgotten experiment long buried beneath dust and guilt. Immerse yourself in haunting visuals, tackle layered match-3 puzzles, and step into a supernatural investigation where the past refuses to stay buried.
